parameters.formTitle: Add a reel to Auto DM
parameters.formDescription: Paste your reel link (or type ALL for every reel), the comment keyword, and what to DM. Use {username} and {link} in messages. Separate variations with || so every DM looks a little different.

values.placeholder: Hey @{username} 👋 Ye raha workflow: {link} || Hi @{username}! Link yaha hai 👉 {link}

values.fieldLabel: Public comment reply (optional, variations separated by ||)

values.formSubmittedText: Reel added ✅ Comments with your keyword will now get an auto DM.

value.dm_message: ={{ String($json.dm_message || '').trim() || 'Hey @{username} 👋 Ye raha aapka link: {link} || Hi @{username}! Link yaha hai 👉 {link}' }}

parameters.content:
## 📸 Instagram Auto DM — setup
1. Create 3 Data tables: **IG AutoDM Settings**, **IG AutoDM Reels**, **IG AutoDM Log** (columns in the guide PDF).
2. Open every Data table node (yellow warning) and pick the matching table.
3. Publish the workflow, then open `/form/ig-auto-dm-connect` and paste your Instagram token.
4. Add a reel with `/form/ig-auto-dm-add-reel` (keyword `*` = any comment).
5. Comment from another account → DM + reply within ~1 minute.

parameters.formDescription: Paste the access token from Meta Developers → Instagram API → Generate token. Your user id and username are filled in automatically.
